detail.longDescription: "Scientists have an indisputable playful side, evidenced by frequent allusions to popular culture in their research publications. That includes popular song lyrics. And the most popular musical group, in terms of how frequently their songs and lyrics appear in the scientific literature, is The Beatles, according to a new paper published in the journal PLoS ONE." https:// arstechnica.com/science/2026/0 9/scientists-really-love-to-reference-the-beatles-in-their-work/ # Research # Music # Lyrics # TheBeatles # Entertainment
